lines: His brothers stand in the palace of Egypt, begging for grain.
Their families are hungry. Their goods are poor. And they plead with the man in charge of Egypt's storehouses: give us full measure... and be charitable to us.
He knows every one of them. They have no idea who he is.
Years ago, these same men threw a little boy into the bottom of a well... and told their father a wolf had eaten him.
That boy is the man standing in front of them.
This is the complete story of Hazrat Yusuf, alayhis salaam, from Surah Yusuf. Allah calls it the best of stories.
